title: TTL Orchestrator: rule-based lifespan profiles, compact provenance bundles, and automated notarization for request artifacts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need predictable, auditable controls over how long prompts, responses, request logs and derived metrics are retained across regions. Existing per-route TTLs are coarse and don’t produce compact, verifiable artifacts for compliance teams.

Goal: Design and deliver a TTL Orchestrator that composes rule-based lifespan profiles (policy-first), emits compact provenance bundles for forensic review, and attaches cryptographic notarization (signed manifests) to exports so auditors can verify chain-of-custody without transferring full raw payloads. The system should respect tenant residency constraints and support sampled exports for high-volume routes.

Scope: product-managed policy DSL for lifespans, orchestration API, console UI for presets and previews, export pipeline that produces compressed provenance bundles (hash chains + minimal metadata), KMS-backed signing for notarization, and a retention simulation/preview endpoint. Integrations: export artifacts to S3/GCS in designated region, integrate with existing retention simulator (PM-9811) and purge orchestrator (ENG-22456).
acceptance_criteria: Policy DSL: create/add lifecycle rules that combine route, tenant residency, and artifact class (prompt/response/log/metric) into a TTL profile and saveable preset
Preview: console and API preview returns a deterministic simulated eviction timeline for a given date range and sample workload
Provenance bundles: export pipeline emits compressed bundles that contain minimal metadata + SHA256 hashes of artifacts and a small schema for quick forensic triage
Notarization: each exported bundle is signed using tenant KMS key (or platform signing key) and verification endpoint returns a verification token and signature chain
Sampling: high-throughput routes can opt into probabilistic sampling with preserved representativeness and clear sampling rate recorded in bundles
Residency enforcement: system honors per-tenant residency constraints and fails exports that would place data in disallowed regions
Auditability: retention events (created/modified/evicted/exported) emit audit records surfaced in Console timeline and audit log export
Security review: feature has completed security checklist and threat modeling before beta release
